purpose: Codex review of ADR-049 (29.09.2026): two failure paths it reproduced with synthetic states, now with the real plan and answer model. A request about the user whose own place is unknown must not get the mother's municipality, while a call made for the mother keeps hers; another person's place named in the user's own request must not replace the user's known municipality. Written before any run; run on the code before and after the change. State expectations added 29.09 after ADR-049 (Codex F5): a right catalogue no longer hides a wrong or rejected state.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn (the catalogue); null when the person the request is about has no known municipality
expectation_help.state_region / person_regions / person /: the saved dialogue state (F5, 29.09): the focus person's region, the user's own region ("user"), whose need the plan read, and that the model's new state was not rejected

scenarios.title: Ema Kose vallas, kasutaja enda koht teadmata

turns.text: Mu ema elab Kose vallas ja vajab koduteenust.
Aga mul endal on ka raske. Kust saan mina oma elukohas abi?

scenarios.title: Kasutaja Harku vallas nimetab naabri Kose valda

turns.text: Elan Harku vallas ja mul on raske toime tulla.
Naabri omavalitsus on Kose vald. Millist abi saan mina oma vallast?
